lines.text: دلالت کند بر سختی سرما در وقت و بسیاری برف و باران و استقامت حال دهقانان و از
lines.en: It indicates the severity of cold in its season, much snow and rain, and the stability of the condition of the peasants. And from

lines.text: مقابله دلالت کند بر حقد و کینه میان مردم و جستن بادها و ظهور عجایبها و گرانی نرخها
lines.en: the opposition, it indicates malice and hatred among the people, the blowing of winds, the appearance of wonders, and the high cost of prices

lines.text: و بدی حال مردم (اتصال قمر بعد از انصراف بزحل در برج حوت) از مقارنۀ دلالت
lines.en: and the bad condition of the people. (The application of the Moon after separation to Saturn in the sign of Pisces) From the conjunction, it indicates

lines.text: کند بر میل هوا بسردی و از تسدیس دلالت کند بر قلت آبها و بدی احوال دهاقین
lines.en: the inclination of the weather to coldness. And from the sextile, it indicates the scarcity of waters and the bad condition of the peasants

lines.text: و حدوث زلزله و از تربیع دلالت کند بر غرق کشتیها و تباهی حال تجار و توسط حال
lines.en: and the occurrence of earthquakes. And from the square, it indicates the sinking of ships, the ruin of the condition of merchants, and the mediocrity of the condition

lines.text: قضاة و فقها و از تثلیث دلالت کند بر قوت کار مشایخ و دهاقین و میل هوا برطوبت
lines.en: of judges and jurists. And from the trine, it indicates the strength of the affairs of sheikhs and peasants, and the inclination of the weather to moisture

lines.text: و برودت و از مقابله دلالت کند بر ظلمت هوا و قلت آب چشمه‌ها و چاهها و جویها *
lines.en: and coldness. And from the opposition, it indicates the darkness of the weather and the scarcity of water in springs, wells, and streams. *

lines.text: اتصال قمر بعد از انصراف از اجتماع و استقبال بمشتری در برج حمل) از مقارنۀ دلالت
lines.en: (The application of the Moon after separation from conjunction and opposition to Jupiter in the sign of Aries) From the conjunction, it indicates

lines.text: کند بر قوت حال اشراف و وزراء و مردم اصیل و گرانی نرخها خاصه نرخ برنج و از تسدیس
lines.en: the strength of the condition of nobles, viziers, and people of noble birth, and the high cost of prices, especially the price of rice. And from the sextile,

lines.text: دلالت کند بر قوت حال اهل سلاح و ارباب خدم و حشم و صافی و صحو هوا و ارزانی نرخها
lines.en: it indicates the strength of the condition of the people of arms, masters of servants and retinues, the clearness and serenity of the weather, and the cheapness of prices

lines.text: و کشاد بازارها و از تربیع دلالت کند بر مخالفت میان سلاطین و خلاف و مباحثه میان
lines.en: and the briskness of markets. And from the square, it indicates opposition among sultans and disagreement and debate among

lines.text: فقها و علما و تباهی ضیاع و از تثلیث دلالت بر ظهور سعادت کند در عالم خاصه در عراق
lines.en: jurists and scholars, and the ruin of estates. And from the trine, it indicates the appearance of happiness in the world, especially in Iraq,

lines.text: و قوت حال اهل قلم و ادب و استقامت احوال اشراف و از مقابله دلالت کند بر خیر و
lines.en: and the strength of the condition of the people of the pen and literature, and the stability of the conditions of nobles. And from the opposition, it indicates good and

lines.text: سعادت در کارهای اهل عالم و ظهور بیماریها در زمین عراق و کدورت اهل صلاح
lines.en: happiness in the affairs of the people of the world, the appearance of diseases in the land of Iraq, and the turbidity of the people of righteousness

lines.text: و علما و ضعف در کار دین (اتصال قمر بعد از انصراف بمشتری در برج ثور) از مقارنۀ
lines.en: and scholars, and weakness in the affairs of religion. (The application of the Moon after separation to Jupiter in the sign of Taurus) From the conjunction,

lines.text: دلالت کند بر قوت اهل صلاح در کارهای مردم و شادی عامه و از تسدیس دلالت کند
lines.en: it indicates the strength of the people of righteousness in the affairs of the people and general joy. And from the sextile, it indicates

lines.text: بر قوت اهل صلاح و استقامت احوال علما و فقها و اصحاب دیانت و توسط حال دبیران
lines.en: the strength of the people of righteousness, the stability of the conditions of scholars, jurists, and people of religion, and the mediocrity of the condition of secretaries

lines.text: و زیادت سعادت مردمان خاصه در ولایت جرجان و طبرستان و از تربیع دلالت کند
lines.en: and the increase of happiness of the people, especially in the province of Gorgan and Tabaristan. And from the square, it indicates

lines.text: بر مخالفت علما و فقها و جدل میان اهل علم و ادب و ارباب مذاهب و فتنه در میان
lines.en: opposition of scholars and jurists, dispute among the people of knowledge and literature and masters of sects, and sedition among

lines.text: اهل صلاح و از تثلیث دلالت کند بر قوت اهل صلاح و ورع و دهاقین و اشراف و بزرگان
lines.en: the people of righteousness. And from the trine, it indicates the strength of the people of righteousness, piety, peasants, nobles, and great men

lines.text: و اهل انشا و ارباب قلم و از مقابله دلالت کند بر توسط احوال وزراء و اهل حرث و نبات
lines.en: and the people of composition and masters of the pen. And from the opposition, it indicates the mediocrity of the conditions of viziers and the people of tillage and plants.

lines.text: (اتصال قمر بعد از انصراف بمشتری در برج جوزا) از مقارنۀ دلالت کند بر نیکی حال
lines.en: (The application of the Moon after separation to Jupiter in the sign of Gemini) From the conjunction, it indicates the goodness of the condition

lines.text: مستوران و جستن بادهای خنک و خوشی هوا و از تسدیس دلالت کند بر ظهور صلاح
lines.en: of the veiled ones, the blowing of cool winds, and the pleasantness of the weather. And from the sextile, it indicates the appearance of righteousness

summary.headline: Moon’s Separation from Conjunction and Opposition
summary.text: Astrological judgments on the Moon’s application after separation from conjunction and opposition, describing weather, agriculture, prices, disease, social conflict, and political conditions under Saturn in Pisces and Jupiter in Aries, Taurus, and Gemini. The omens include earthquakes, shipwrecks, market prosperity, and conditions in Iraq, Gorgan, and Tabaristan according to the conjunction, sextile, square, trine, and opposition.
